deck.name: 日常造句
deck.description: 日常生活高频句，打乱词块后按正确语序还原

sentences.text: I would like a cup of coffee.
What time do you usually wake up?
She is reading a book in the park.
We are going to the supermarket.
Could you please close the window?
The weather is really nice today.
I have lived here for five years.
He forgot to bring his umbrella.
Would you mind turning down the music?
sentences.translation: 你介意把音乐调小一点吗？

sentences.text: They have been friends since childhood.
I am looking forward to the weekend.
The bus arrives at the station every ten minutes.
sentences.translation: 公交车每十分钟到站一班。

sentences.text: She decided to take a walk after dinner.
I cannot find my keys anywhere in the room.
sentences.translation: 我在房间里哪儿都找不到钥匙。

sentences.text: It took me an hour to finish the homework.
sentences.translation: 我花了一个小时完成作业。

sentences.text: You should drink more water on hot days.
sentences.translation: 天热的时候你应该多喝水。

sentences.text: The movie was much better than I expected.
sentences.translation: 这部电影比我预期的好得多。

sentences.text: We had to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
sentences.translation: 因为下雨，我们不得不取消野餐。

sentences.text: Learning a language requires constant practice.
sentences.translation: 学习一门语言需要持续练习。

sentences.text: I will pick you up at the airport tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: 我明天早上到机场接你。
